name: Voice help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Voice plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Say a command
entries.text: Talk to every app from here: say or type what you want (add 12.50 dunkin food, list expenses, open builds), and Molly runs it through the Dev Console's voice commands and answers.

entries.title: Say it
entries.text: Sends what you typed. Reads and opening screens run at once; a change asks only for what is missing; deleting always asks first.

entries.title: Speak
entries.text: Listens through the microphone where the browser can. Tap again to stop.

entries.title: Yes
entries.text: Confirms the command Molly asked about and runs it.

entries.title: What can I say
entries.text: Lists the phrases one app understands.
